```markdown
- **Reference number:** POC-BB2C61BC1B-86183
- **Date of denial notice:** 2026-08-18
- **Plan:** Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (Commercial/ACA), New Hampshire
- **Governing policy:** Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Musculoskeletal — Joint Surgery (https://guidelines.carelonmedicalbenefitsmanagement.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/PDF-Joint-Surgery-2025-11-15.pdf)

---

Dear Appeals Reviewer,

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for the rotator cuff repair (CPT 29827) requested by my orthopedic surgeon, Dr. Okafor. The notice dated 2026-08-18 states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am asking the plan to reconsider that decision.

I understand this review is governed by the Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Musculoskeletal — Joint Surgery. Below I set out the plan's own language, in quotation marks, and match each item to what is already in my records. My surgeon has documented that this procedure is needed, and the records were assembled by my treating providers for exactly this purpose.

## The plan's criteria and the evidence in my records

**1. Imaging.** The policy states:

> "Imaging report. The provider shall submit a detailed imaging report for studies obtained within the past 12 months. In the absence of a detailed report, the provider may submit a report from an independent radiologist."

My records include an MRI of the shoulder dated 2026-06-15 — well within the past 12 months — reporting a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy.

**2. The category of tear.** The policy states:

> "Rotator cuff repair is considered medically necessary for a chronic or degenerative full thickness tear when ALL the following criteria are met:"

and, among those criteria:

> "Recent advanced imaging confirms features of a degenerative full thickness tear"

> "Gradual onset of shoulder pain in the absence of a significant traumatic event within the preceding 3 months"

My records document 14 months of progressive shoulder pain, unrelieved by rest, with no traumatic event described. The MRI of 2026-06-15 confirms a full-thickness supraspinatus tear with grade 2 fatty atrophy. This is a gradual-onset, degenerative presentation, not an acute injury.

**3. Pain and effect on daily activities.** The policy states:

> "Pain ≥ 3 on the VAS scale which interferes with age-appropriate activities of daily living"

My records document that I cannot lift my arm above shoulder height and cannot sleep on the affected side, and that my range of motion is limited by pain. My exam also documents positive provocative testing on the affected side. If the plan requires the numeric pain score specifically, that value appears in [VAS score as recorded in Dr. Okafor's office notes / the physical therapy records], and I ask that those notes be reviewed rather than the request being closed as incomplete.

**4. Conservative management.** The policy states:

> "Conservative management1 must include a combination of strategies to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and correct underlying dysfunction, including physical therapy AND at least ONE complementary conservative treatment strategy."

> "Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative management"

> "Patient has completed a full course of conservative management (as defined above) for the current episode of care"

My records document supervised physical therapy focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics — 24 visits over 16 weeks, from 2026-04-06 to 2026-07-27, with a physical therapy discharge note. Alongside that physical therapy, I completed more than one complementary strategy: NSAIDs for 6 months with inadequate relief, and a corticosteroid injection on 2026-06-02 that gave only 4 weeks of partial relief. The 16 weeks of physical therapy exceeds the six weeks the policy requires, and the course was carried through to discharge for this episode of care.

**5. Tobacco.** The policy states:

> "For primary rotator cuff repair, adherence to a tobacco cessation program resulting in abstinence from tobacco and nicotine products for at least 6 weeks prior to surgery is strongly recommended."

My records state that I am a non-smoker.

**6. Other items in my records.** My records also document no active infection, no untreated substance use, and a BMI of 29.

## Request regarding the stated reason for denial

The denial says the documentation was incomplete, but it does not tell me which specific criterion the plan found unsupported or which document it believes is missing. Several of the policy passages I have quoted above end in a colon and introduce lists of further conditions that I have not been given, so I cannot confirm that I have addressed every item the reviewer applied.

I therefore ask the plan to identify, in writing, the exact criteria it applied and the specific document or finding it considers missing. If a particular record is needed, I will ask Dr. Okafor's office to send it promptly. I would also note that where I have not quoted a threshold above, it is because that threshold does not appear in the policy language available to me; I am not asking the plan to apply any standard other than its own.

## What I am asking for

Please overturn the denial of prior authorization for rotator cuff repair (CPT 29827) and approve the procedure, or, if the plan maintains its decision, provide a written explanation identifying the precise criterion that was not met and the documentation required to meet it, together with information about my further appeal rights, including external review.

I understand my appeal must be received by 2027-02-14, which is 180 days from the date of the denial notice. I am sending this letter to the appeal address printed on my denial letter. I understand I may also submit or check on my appeal by logging in at anthem.com or through the Sydney Health app, or by calling the number on the back of my ID card.

Thank you for taking the time to review this. I am glad to provide anything further that would help.

Sincerely,

**Emerson Foster**
Member ID: W511360146
Reference number: POC-BB2C61BC1B-86183

[Signature]
[Date]

**Enclosures:** [MRI report dated 2026-06-15]; [Physical therapy discharge note, 2026-04-06 to 2026-07-27]; [Office notes from Dr. Okafor]; [Injection record dated 2026-06-02]; [Copy of denial notice dated 2026-08-18]

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
```
